purpose: Track implemented learning artifacts and remaining curriculum without treating proposed work as authorization.

status_definitions.complete: The described artifact exists or the discussion was completed. This does not assert a fresh test run or live infrastructure verification.
status_definitions.todo: Work remains before acceptance. Code may already exist; consult implementation_state and remaining_work.

scope_definitions.accepted: Established project work or explicitly authorized current work.
scope_definitions.proposed: Curriculum goal requiring scope agreement before implementation.

maintenance_rules: Keep task IDs stable; reference IDs in discussions, commits, and pull requests.
Read linked source and tests before acting; this task list does not override code or project instructions.
Work on one lesson component at a time. Obtain explicit authorization before advancing to another component.
Before marking a task complete, satisfy its acceptance criteria and record relevant evidence and verification limits.
Track test execution separately from implementation. Never infer a passing test run from the presence of tests.
Keep HTTP contracts in route metadata and schemas. Use this file for progress, not a duplicate endpoint specification.
Do not implement hypothetical payment, order, reservation, or domain-event examples as existing requirements.
Do not read or index learnings/, docs/ai/, or QA.md to maintain this list.

current_focus.title: Delete books and define resource lifecycle
current_focus.next_action: The learner authorized continuing to BOOK-016. Agree on deletion lifecycle and HTTP semantics before implementation. Proposed for discussion: hard deletion with required If-Match, 204 on success, 404 for missing or already deleted books, existing 400/428/412 precondition errors, and ISBN reuse after deletion.

previous_component_verification.basis: 2026-10-22 continuation: fresh uv run pytest passed 87 tests with 9 MySQL cases skipped. uv run ruff check . and uv run ruff format --check . passed; uv run basedpyright reported 0 errors and warnings. Whitespace checks passed. Index left unchanged.
previous_component_verification.mysql: 2026-10-22 continuation: ./scripts/test_integration.py passed alembic upgrade head, alembic check (no schema drift), and all 50 integration tests, including 9 live MySQL persistence cases. Competing connections proved stale writes cannot overwrite accepted changes, unchanged writes advance the version, and uncommitted updates roll back details and version.
previous_component_verification.deployment: The isolated test database was already at head, so the runner did not reapply the revision. A standalone verification harness executed the actual 8c214e7a93b0 upgrade/downgrade functions against a connection-local temporary books table in test MySQL: oversized existing titles and authors were rejected before DDL with data preserved; valid boundary-length rows survived upgrade with version 1; omitted versions received server default 1; downgrade removed only the version column and preserved rows. Permanent tables were not downgraded. This verifies revision operations and preflight, not a fresh full Alembic deployment or production rollout.

tasks.title: Manage transaction and session lifetimes explicitly

acceptance_criteria: Unit of Work owns session cleanup.
